title: Family Life
description: Talk about yourself and about your family and say what you want for your future with I want to + verb and I'd like to + verb; narrate past events with the past simple and the irregular verbs of the lesson (become, feel, grow, hold, keep, know, make, say, stride); and build the present perfect with have or has + past participle to tie a past event to the present, with its markers since (a starting point), for (a length of time), yet, already, ever and never, and the frame it is the first time…, against the past simple of an action finished at a named moment (yesterday, last year, in 2015, two months ago) — all through the vocabulary of family life (stepmother, stepmum, siblings, grandchild, Nan, support, guidance, security, protection, appreciation, care, trouble, path), the adjectives that describe a person (proud, kind, arrogant, selfish, caring, affectionate) and the words of the story (delight, grin, melt, shriek, clutch, bunch, astonished, stare, weigh somebody up)
